thread:
maya_cs: Heads-up — prepping QBR for Apollo. Onboarding cohort #3 shows a token burn spike on day 2 after we enabled embeddings. Need a short triage and an enablement play for next week. :eyes:
liam_csm: Ugh, saw that in the spike alert. Do we have the raw numbers? avg tok/day vs expected?
olivia_finops: I pulled a quick forecast. Rough numbers: expected ~120k tokens/day, observed ~430k tokens/day for the cohort. Early commit is 50k credits/mo. Forecasted monthly burn if trend continues: ~9.3M tokens (~$3.7k).
sam_engineer: billing-bot posted an alert at 09:12: `usage anomaly: account=apollo, pct_change=+260%`. Repro steps: customers enabled `embed_similarity_cache=false` by accident in client SDK.
maya_cs: Good catch, @sam_engineer — can you paste the relevant client snippet so CS can advise the customer?
sam_engineer: Here it is:
```
// JS
client.config({ embeddings: { cache: false } })
```
We'll suggest switching to `cache: true` and setting batch_size=32.
liam_csm: Also want to surface an onboarding heatmap to the customer ops team. Maya — can you prepare a 5-slide QBR appendix: 1) spike timeline 2) root cause (cache off) 3) mitigations 4) forecasted cost impact 5) recommended SLA/guardrails?
maya_cs: Will do. Drafting now. Quick question: should we propose a temporary quota or throttling rule while they fix SDK?
olivia_finops: Yes — propose a soft cap: rate limit to 5 reqs/sec for embeddings for 48 hours, and an alert if 24h spend > $1,500. Include rollback instructions.
liam_csm: I'll own customer outreach and the enablement walk-through. @sam_engineer can you create a one-click snippet the CS rep can send? small code block + explanation.
sam_engineer: On it. I'll add a repo gist and post link in this thread. ETA 45m.
billing-bot: automated: "created ticket #CS-8397: Apollo cost spike — triage required"
maya_cs: Tagging enablement for a short session Friday 10am PT. Agenda: quick SDK fix, caching best practices, monitoring hooks. Anyone object?
olivia_finops: Works for me. I'll bring an estimated remediation plan and cost delta slide.
liam_csm: No objections. After the session we'll add an action item in the QBR appendix to recommend a pre-commit credit buffer for future activations. :white_check_mark:
maya_cs: Thanks team — I'll upload the draft slides to the shared QBR folder and ping when ready. Linking playbook for reference: https://redwood-internal/playbooks/onboarding-costs
liam_csm: Nice. Also add a short checklist for renewal risk: if post-remediation burn stays >2x commit, flag renewal for finance review.
maya_cs: Noted. Closing loop once slides + gist posted.
sam_engineer: Gist uploaded: https://gist.github.com/sam/abc123 — contains code + `cache: true` example + recommended batch config.
maya_cs: Perfect, thanks. I'll circulate to Apollo CSM and schedule Friday invite. :calendar:
